# Citable Studio

> Citable Studio is a studio for AI search visibility, also called generative engine optimization (GEO). It audits how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews read a business website, then fixes the issues that keep the business out of AI answers.

## What the studio does

- Free snapshot: a one-page summary sent within two working days, with a score out of 100, an AI crawler access check and the three biggest blockers.
- Audit and fixes: a full audit in six areas for a fixed price, followed by the fixes: crawler access, llms.txt, structured data and rewrites of up to five key pages. From $390, one-off.
- Monthly: a monthly re-audit, tracking of AI mentions for the client's questions, new citable content and brand mention work. From $590 a month.

## How the score is built

The score out of 100 weights six areas: AI citability 25%, brand authority 20%, content quality 20%, technical foundations 15%, structured data 10%, platform fit 10%.

## What the studio does not promise

Nobody controls what an AI engine chooses to cite. The studio removes known blockers, makes content easier to quote and reports before and after results. It does not guarantee citations.
